title: fix(plugin-chatbot): the AI quota notice offers an upgrade only when the refusal names one
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8P23qC5iZwu8UHz5wao8WP6)_

Refs objectstack-ai/cloud#4853

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new published language-pack key, `chatbotQuota.limitTitle`, in every locale
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:付费团队在 AI 输入框碰到五小时用量上限时,提示改为「AI 额度已用尽」加恢复时间,不再出现「需要升级」和「升级方案」按钮;周额度用完时按钮是「购买额度包」;免费版照旧提示升级。
- 为什么做:属于云端分区的 AI 额度提示修正,替付费团队解决「已付费却被要求升级」的误导。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某类额度提示少了或多了一个按钮,文字仍是服务器原话,可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- `useAiQuotaCopy` (plugin-chatbot `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`) now returns a `title` and a nullable `cta`, both read from the refusal's own `upgrade` / `topUp` flags (already parsed by `parseAiQuotaError`):
  - `topUp: true` → neutral title, "Buy a credit pack" action (unchanged action, title no longer says upgrade);
  - `upgrade: true` → "Upgrade needed" + "Upgrade plan" (unchanged);
  - neither (paid five-hour pace; developer organization, which sends `upgrade:false` and no `topUp` key) → neutral title and **no action**; the server's sentence already says when it frees up.
- `ErrorBanner`'s quota branch and `QuotaBlockedNextStep` (confirm card blocked state) render the action only when `cta` is set, same gating as the dock's `AiUsageIndicator` / `ChatDock` (`pool.upgrade || pool.topUp`).
- New key `chatbotQuota.limitTitle` ("AI limit reached" / 「AI 额度已用尽」) in all 11 `@object-ui/i18n` locales that carry `chatbotQuota.*`.
- One patch changeset (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/i18n`).

Mechanism check: the composer receives the cloud guardrail's 429 (cloud main e09f45c, `ai-token-guardrail-plugin.ts`), which carries no `planType` / `resetKind`, only `error.details.{messageEn, upgrade, topUp, resetsTonight, resetsAt}`. Test fixtures are that body per plan; the card's usage-door words are in the test names so the acceptance reads 1:1.

## Tests

<details><summary>Targeted + package runs, ablation</summary>

- New describe in `ChatbotEnhanced.quotaResetPromise-7587.test.tsx` (zh pack via `I18nProvider`): paid five-hour `{planType:'paid', resetKind:'fiveHour', upgrade:false, topUp:false}` → no 「需要升级」, no 「升级方案」 button, zero buttons, text exactly `AI 额度已用尽` + server sentence; developer plan → no heading, no button; paid weekly `topUp:true` → 「购买额度包」 calls `onUpgrade`, no 「升级方案」; free `upgrade:true` → heading and 「升级方案」 stay.
- New describe in `ChatbotEnhanced.quotaBlockedConfirm.test.tsx`: paid five-hour on the confirm card → reason shown, `proposed-changes-quota-upgrade` absent.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/i18n/` → Test Files 214 passed (214), Tests 3103 passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` → both Done, exit 0.
- Ablation (fix committed first; `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` restored to the merge base, `limitTitle` count 0 on disk): 4 failed / 8 passed — the three new non-free banner cases and the confirm-card case red, the free case green as expected; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, blob hash matched HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- When both flags are true (no producer sends that today) `topUp` wins the action, as before.
- The dispatch asked for a model-named `Co-Authored-By` commit trailer; the pre-push gate `check:commit-card-trailers` refuses model identifiers, so commits carry the model-free pair.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families at head 935c1d85</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`: 41 families derived from the merge base b8c8c8897; all 41 run locally, each exit 0 (40 unlocked `check:*` / self-tests; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the verify lock: Test Files 172 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 5130 passed).
- `--ran` reconciliation: 41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- Repo-wide scans and the full UI farm (`Lint UI`, `Test UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`) are CI's.

</details>

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.quotaResetPromise-7587.test.tsx` — expect 6 passed, including the `resetKind fiveHour` case.

Read first: `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` `useAiQuotaCopy` (the title/cta choice is the risk hunk), then `ErrorBanner`'s quota branch.
